create.name: Lee Carroll
create.bio:
Lee Carroll has channelled the messages he calls Kryon since 1989, and his site describes him as the original Kryon channel. The messages are hopeful in tone: they speak of a shift in human consciousness now under way, address listeners as old souls returning to what they already know, and treat intuition as an ability every person has. Carroll has written seventeen Kryon books, published in some two dozen languages.

For many years he has taught alongside Monika Muranyi, and the two now present most of the work together. They travel for seminars and retreats in places such as Mount Shasta, Sedona and Vancouver Island, often sharing the stage with other teachers, and they release new channellings and conversations on the Kryon YouTube channel each week, along with a weekly online show, Wednesdays with Kryon, in which they talk with guests about consciousness. Through their online school they offer recorded courses on intuition and on the Lemurian Teaching Wheel, a set of core spiritual principles that Kryon attributes to an ancient culture in what is now Hawaii, and a monthly channelled meditation series called the Green Mist.

courses.title: Intuition
courses.description: An online course with Lee Carroll and Monika Muranyi on understanding intuition and practising it until it becomes something you can expect to use. It treats intuition as a natural ability every person has.

courses.title: The Lemurian Teaching Wheel Master Class Series
courses.description: A seven-module course on the core spiritual principles that Kryon associates with the Lemurian Teaching Wheel. Presented by Lee Carroll and Monika Muranyi as a refresher for old souls.

courses.title: The Green Mist
courses.description: A monthly series of meditations channelled by Lee Carroll, offered as a subscription. Each one invites a quieter, deeper sense of the inner self.

courses.title: Kryon Divine Intervention Experience Retreat (Sedona)
courses.description: A weekend retreat in Sedona, Arizona, with Lee Carroll and Monika Muranyi alongside Dr. Clint G. Rogers. Organised by Shaloha Productions.

courses.title: Kryon Lighthouses of the Earth Retreat
courses.description: A retreat in Nanaimo on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, with Lee Carroll and Monika Muranyi. Organised by Shaloha Productions.

free_resources.title: Free Kryon Audio Channellings
free_resources.description: A free archive of Kryon channellings by year, with the most recent ones released weekly on the Kryon YouTube channel. Also includes the Parables of Kryon series.
